seo.description: Generate 3–10-second Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 videos from text, frames, references, or source video at 360p through 4K with native audio.

overview: Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 is Google’s direct multimodal video route for generation, reference-led creation, first/last-frame control, video editing, extension, and conversational refine.

hero.title: Gemini Omni Flash 1.1
hero.subtitle: Create and edit 3–10-second video at 360p, 720p, 1080p, or 4K with references, frame control, and native audio.
hero.paragraph: Choose Omni Flash 1.1 when the workflow continues beyond one render: generate from text or images, edit or extend a source clip, then refine the stored interaction.

features.title: 360p through 4K
features.body: Choose a resolution that matches fast exploration, review, or final delivery.

features.title: Multimodal creation and editing
features.body: Generate from text, images, references, first and last frames, or edit and extend an owned source video.

features.title: Conversational refine
features.body: Continue a stored interaction to revise the same creative direction without rebuilding the workflow.

features.title: Native audio
features.body: Direct dialogue, ambience, effects, and music with the picture.

decisionCards.title: Best for multimodal iteration
decisionCards.body: Use Omni Flash 1.1 when references, video edits, extension, and follow-up refine belong in one Google workflow.

referenceWorkflows.title: Generate
referenceWorkflows.body: Start with text, one source image, up to ten reference images, or first and last frames.

referenceWorkflows.title: Edit and extend
referenceWorkflows.body: Transform or continue an owned source clip with visual and sound direction.

referenceWorkflows.title: Refine
referenceWorkflows.body: Use a stored interaction to request a focused follow-up change.

section.title: Prompt Lab — Gemini Omni Flash 1.1
section.intro: Separate the visual action, camera path, and sound direction.
section.tip: Keep the main action observable and give sound cues a clear event to follow.

demo.title: Night-shift bicycle mechanic
demo.prompt: Visual direction: An anonymous night-shift bicycle mechanic, seen from behind with the face out of frame, seats a tire on a spinning wheel beneath one workshop lamp. Camera direction: A smooth waist-high arc while spokes flash and rubber flexes. Sound direction: Precise ratchet clicks with soft rain against the windows.
notes: Keep the main action observable and give sound cues a clear event to follow.
